comments.author: @youngmoon8762
comments.text:
Please, don't come to Korea. Too many foreigners already. Please Please Please go to Japan or China. Japan and China are much bigger than Korea and have a lot of things to enjoy. Korea is an industrialized country, so there are not many things for tourists. 
I live in Korea. We already have an issue due to too many foreigners. Not easy to get a train ticket; people are getting hostile toward each other, and the price of groceries and housing is going up. Please don't make us lose our warm hearts to other people.

comments.author: @kevinkim1418
comments.text:
I’ve been coming to Korea for last 3years staying over a month each time I visit. And still can’t get enough of it. Every time I come here there’s something new things to do and places to explore. 
I’m currently in Korea again. This time I made Seoul as base camp and went to Japan for a week. Perfect place in Asia, conveniently located so that you can visit other Asian Countries. 
Will be coming back again and again~~.
